verdict.rationale: Pika runs a vendor-owned developer platform with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, llms.txt, and machine-readable per-operation pages, so a documented public API exists. The evidence describes it as an aggregator for generating media with hosted third-party models; it does not show that Pika's own creative apps (Product Ad, Short Film, Swap Anything, etc.) can be driven through it, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: evidence that the API exposes Pika's own app workflows rather than only hosted-model generation, a sandbox or test environment, versioning/deprecation/changelog documentation, an interactive try-it console on the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
